questions.subject: FILM_STUDIES
questions.learningObjective: Define and distinguish key film studies concepts
questions.stem: Which statement best defines Editing?

options.text: It is the process of selecting and joining shots to construct a coherent, meaningful sequence.
It is the juxtaposition of shots to compress time or generate an idea through their collision.
It is an instantaneous transition from one shot to the next at a chosen frame.
It is an approach that maintains spatial and temporal coherence so that cuts feel invisible.

questions.explanation: It is the process of selecting and joining shots to construct a coherent, meaningful sequence. This is precisely what Editing means; the alternatives describe Montage, Cut, Continuity editing, which are different ideas.
questions.hint: Recall the specific meaning of Editing.
